rule.licence: read live (archive book JSON and CMS) for every book whose slug has 'chemistry': CC BY books are public tier 0; chemistry-2e and chemistry-atoms-first-2e (CC BY-NC-SA, both places) are private tier 1 and organic-chemistry private tier 2, used only if the first tiers do not give enough; anything else is refused
rule.private_tier: CC BY-NC-SA sections are a private measurement: their PDFs and gold are in the cache outside the repository, this file holds ids, counts and hashes only, and only aggregate numbers with attribution and the licence named are published
rule.stop: the walk stops at 4 sections with at least 100 chemistry gold equations, never above 8
rule.unused: section not named by any earlier set; sibling editions folded; a section whose title (slug without numbers) an earlier set has is out; so is any section of dev-v2's books that could be in its sealed check part, and any with a title one of those has
rule.overlap_reference: word 8-grams outside maths of every used or sealed section of the pool's books and of the sections already taken
rule.order: tier, then SHA-256 of 'fresh5-D|book|section', smallest first; each that passes is taken
